normative_extracts.quote: A service worker intercepts fetch events for requests within its scope and may respond with a synthesized Response object via respondWith().
page.routeFromHAR() matches outgoing browser requests against recorded HAR entries and fulfills them with the archived status, headers, and body.

pipeline_phases: Service Worker or CDP Fetch.requestPaused Interception
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Browser-layer interception captures real Request objects below fetch/XHR bindings and fulfills them from handlers or HAR archives while preserving headers, status codes, and ReadableStream bodies.

production_failures.symptom: Streaming AI chat UI crashes in production on chunked UTF-8 boundaries after passing all mocked tests
production_failures.root_cause: Unit tests stubbed globalThis.fetch with a single buffered JSON string instead of a multi-chunk ReadableStream.
production_failures.mitigation: Intercept at the network layer and return a chunked ReadableStream response that splits multi-byte characters across chunks.

production_failures.symptom: CI E2E suite passes against stale HAR fixtures while production API returns 422
production_failures.root_cause: HAR file was recorded months earlier and never refreshed or validated against the OpenAPI/Zod schema.
production_failures.mitigation: Validate HAR response payloads against shared backend schemas in CI and set notFound: 'abort'.
